cells.text: The Solar-Element Grenades named "Solar Grenades" have Fastball intrinsically and last 2 seconds longer. Powered Melee Kills grant 5 seconds of Sunbracers Ready. On Grenade Ability Usage while Sunbracers Ready is active: Grants Sunbracers buff for 4 seconds. Sunbracers grants 20,000% Additional Base "Solar Grenade" Grenade Regeneration Rate.

supplementary_snapshot.text:
Grenades travel ~25% faster and farther.
Strength of the effect varies between grenades.

official.retrieval: Official search-index excerpt; full page and alternate host did not load in web tool.
official.supports: Historical extra duration reduced from four to two seconds; regeneration tuned for four versus five grenades; Ready should be removed when a grenade is thrown.
Stat rework intended comparable Sunbracers behavior at 70 grenade stat; threshold bug expected fixed in 9.0.0.4. Does not provide a complete current rate formula.

official.retrieval: Official legacy item page; not a current numerical table.
official.supports: Description says Solar melee kills and brief unlimited Solar Grenade energy; numerical reference uses powered-melee qualification and finite regeneration.

calibration.intrinsic_fastball: Required source parameter fastball_speed_delta; .25 used in tests, not exact per-grenade D2 measurement.
calibration.lifetime: Solar source 4/6 plus exotic 2 gives 6/8; inherited synthetic phase correction produces 6.25/8.25 in tests.
calibration.throw_count: Tests pay five throws at 0,1,2,3,4 seconds including initial charge and the boundary throw; no throw-animation gate or hardcoded count. Not a claim about current native D2 throw capacity.

implementation.scope: Powered-melee kill receipt, five-second Ready, accepted grenade use consumes Ready and activates four seconds of additional-base regeneration for the selected Solar Grenade account. Passive two-second duration and explicit calibrated intrinsic Fastball.
policies: Selected base ability must carry solar_grenade. Kill must belong to wearer, carry melee_kill and retained melee_ability source qualification; damage with unknown result cannot arm.

Duplicate death IDs suppressed within explicit 60-second receipt retention. A distinct powered kill may rearm during the active window; another accepted use resets active duration. This is an explicit policy, not a verified current D2 refresh measurement.
Heat Rises consumption activates from a selected Solar Grenade; failed costs do not consume Ready. Paid unknown projectile launch preserves activation and payment and cannot replay.
Last tagged exotic source removal and wearer death clear Ready, active and receipt states. Accepted grenade fields and launched projectiles retain previously captured values.
Lifetime and throw-speed modifiers require actual Solar Grenade ability event tags; weapon-created Solar effects cannot borrow them. Duplicate intrinsic sources use max family reduction.

Regeneration is additional 200 times the unscaled base plus the normal stat-scaled rate; it neither grants infinite energy nor alters chunk grants. Benevolence adds its own base term and its minus-ten grenade stat still participates.
Real Lightweight Knife is a powered-melee producer for host tests, not a legal Warlock loadout. Full class constraints and Warlock melee producers remain separate work.

uncertainties: Clarity says roughly 132 percent charge per second while current source cooldown is 199.5 seconds. 201/199.5 is roughly 100.75 percent per second at zero stat; the Clarity approximation matches 201/152. This arithmetic suggests a stale cooldown-derived approximation, not a proven version diagnosis.

Official 2024 throw-count tuning and 2025 stat-rework statement do not independently verify current regeneration at every stat, animation rate, countdown endpoint or available throws. Preserve explicit version conflict, do not add a fixed four-throw cap.

Compendium/Clarity powered-melee wording differs from legacy item Solar-melee text. Retained melee status/ignition kill qualification, rearming while active, Ready refresh, Heat Rises consumption and loadout switching need original-game verification.
Fastball strength varies by grenade; .25 delta, physical trajectory and field timing remain explicit calibration. No claim of complete Fastball mod support for every grenade.

Full Warlock subclass/equipment assembly, Incinerator Snap/Celestial Fire producers, all exotic/fragment/artifact interactions, production catalog, HUD/assets and physical process restart are unfinished.
